description: Illustrative custom control templates written for this project. They are not official framework text. Organizations adopt them into their own register and adapt them.

templates.title: Information security policy
templates.description: An information security policy is approved by management, published to staff and reviewed at least annually.

templates.title: Quarterly access reviews
templates.description: Access rights to in-scope systems are reviewed quarterly by system owners and inappropriate access is removed.

templates.title: Privileged access management
templates.description: Privileged accounts are inventoried, justified and reviewed at least every 90 days.

templates.title: Multi-factor authentication for administrators
templates.description: Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all privileged and administrative accounts.

templates.title: Vulnerability management
templates.description: Systems are scanned for vulnerabilities at least monthly and findings are remediated within defined timeframes.

templates.title: Security logging and monitoring
templates.description: Security-relevant events are logged centrally, retained and monitored for anomalies.

templates.title: Incident response plan
templates.description: An incident response plan defines roles, escalation and communication and is tested at least annually.

templates.title: Backups are performed and restore-tested
templates.description: Critical data is backed up on schedule and restoration is tested at least twice a year.

templates.title: Third-party security assessments
templates.description: Vendors with access to sensitive data or systems are assessed before onboarding and reassessed on schedule.

templates.title: AI system inventory and approval
templates.description: AI systems are inventoried with an accountable owner and approved through a risk assessment before deployment.

templates.title: Records of processing activities
templates.description: A record of processing activities is maintained and reviewed annually.

templates.title: Remediation tracked to closure
templates.description: Identified security gaps have owners and due dates, and overdue items are escalated.
